title: Synch event envelope v2.0.0 (daemon-persisted form)
description: Spec 'Persistent state' (typed, versioned, numbered events persisted before acknowledgement). This is the shape persisted by the daemon. Runner-local events use events/runner-event.schema.json and are mapped on ingest (catalogue.md section 3). This is a producer schema; readers follow README.md 'Compatibility'.

id.description: Unique event ID. For ingested runner events: the runner-assigned event ID.

stream.description: One stream per thread plus one 'system' stream. Runner journals are not daemon streams; their events are ingested into the owning thread stream.

seq.description: Per-stream sequence. Starts at 1, contiguous, assigned in the persisting transaction.

global_seq.description: Daemon-wide sequence across all streams. Contiguous. Assigned by the daemon at persistence (also for ingested runner events).

type_version.description: Payload schema major version for this type.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened at its source (runner clock for ingested events).

request_id.description: Client request ID that caused this event, if any (receipts.md).

causation_id.description: Event ID that caused this one.

source.description: Required on events ingested from a runner journal; forbidden otherwise. (runner, seq) is the unique ingest dedup key.

redactions.description: Number of known secret values redacted from the payload before persistence.

machine.description: Host the actor acted on/from (spec 'Evidence and diagnostics').
